_comment: Parameters of the thermodynamic estimators (src/thermo/estimate.rs). Every number is either a recalled reference value (CODATA / NBS standard entropies of the elements, Kopp's atomic heat capacities, Latimer's solid entropy contributions) or fitted to the seeded NBS rows of the species store by the gates in tests/open_items.rs (rms errors recorded below). Tier of everything derived from here: Estimated.

element_entropy._comment: Standard entropy of the element in its reference state, J/(mol K), and the number of atoms per formula unit of that state (H2, O2, ... are diatomic). NBS / CODATA.

solid_entropy_latimer._comment: Latimer's additive element contributions to the standard entropy of a solid compound, J/(mol K); rms 17 J/(mol K) over the 29 seeded solids.

solid_cp_kopp._comment: Kopp's atomic heat capacities of elements in solid compounds at 298 K, J/(mol K) (Kopp-Neumann rule).

liquid_cp_kopp._comment: Kopp's atomic heat capacities of elements in liquid compounds at 298 K, J/(mol K).

ion_entropy._comment: Conventional entropy S(298) of an aqueous ion, J/(mol K), S = a + b (3/2 R ln M) + c |z| / (r + k)^2 with M the molar mass and r the radius in Angstrom (Powell-Latimer form), fitted per class to the seeded NBS ions. monatomic cations: 15 ions, rms 16.5; monatomic anions: 6 ions, rms 14.1; polyatomic anions: S = a + b M^(1/3) + c |z| (16 ions, rms 38); polyatomic cations use the monatomic-cation form.
